Hours Per Week: up to 38
Requisition ID: REQ676312

Position Title: Registered Nurse (RN 2-8), Primary Care - Various positions - Aldavilla, Mid North Coast Correctional Centre
 

If you are passionate about delivering healthcare with the greatest impact, then come and join us at the Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network (JHFMHN). We are Just the Placeto grow your career and be part of a valued team delivering care where it's needed most!

Be part of a supportive environment, where you can apply your skills to address complex healthcare needs while broadening your treatment capabilities to maximise patient outcomes. 

We are a challenging yet rewarding place to take your career even further. With industry-leading safety standards, you can focus on doing your best work alongside skilled colleagues while gaining job training to progress your career.

To learn more about careers in our network, please click links below:

Welcome - Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network (nsw.gov.au)

Our Locations - Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network (nsw.gov.au)

Our Health Services - Justice Health and Forensic Mental Health Network (nsw.gov.au)

The Role

We're currently looking for a qualified Registered Nurse currently registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA) and at least one full year of nursing experience.

The Registered Nurse performs reception screening and comprehensive health assessments on persons received into custody whilst assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating nursing management.

Our Location
Mid North Coast Correctional Centre is a maximum-, medium- and minimum- security centre for males and females. It is located at Aldavilla, 455km north of Sydney and 14 km west of Kempsey.

Salary & Benefits

Your salary plus superannuation is just the beginning. You'll also have access to:

Additional allowances that may apply

Access to salary packaging benefits

A fitness passport (if you're eligible)

Fantastic training & education opportunities available

A dynamic & varied working environment where no two days are the same

Diversity & Inclusivity

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We employ all ages and genders, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, culturally and linguistically diverse groups, the LGBTQIA+ community, veterans, refugees and people with disability.

*This is also a Targeted Aboriginal Position. Preference will be given to applicants of Aboriginal descent. Exemption is claimed under Section 21 of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Ready to Apply?

The first step is to submit your resume and your answers to the following targeted questions:

How do you contribute to creating a positive and collaborative work environment among healthcare professionals?

Describe a situation where you had to advocate for a patient's needs or preferences. How did you ensure that the patient's voice was heard in their care plan?

Need more information? 
 1) Click here for the Position Description 
 2) Find out more about applying for this position
For role related queries or questions contact Deni Ring on Deni.Ring@health.nsw.gov.au

Applications Close: 21 July 2026 at 11:59pm AEST    Click here to Apply now →

Full Time Accountant
Salary $85,000 to $100,000 + SUPERANNUATION

DUTIES
•	Preparing profit and loss accounts and balance sheet reports. 
•	Preparing asset account, liability account and capital account entries by analyzing account information. 
•	Provides financial assistance by inspecting accounting options. 
•	Does payroll. 
•	Analyze data collected to determine the state of the company's financial health. 
•	Analyze data to understand where the company is generating revenue or losing revenue. 
•	Preparation of financial reports that shows the company's profits, equity and cash flow. 
•	Taking care of the inventory process. 
•	Collecting and analyzing data which is used in the estimates of each container import. 
•	Collecting and analyzing the accounting information to prepare special financial reports and assists in preparing budgets and forecasting. 
•	Conducts internal audit. 
•	Maintains accuracy in financial records by examining it. 
•	Secure the financial information by database backups. 
•	Maintains financial security by following internal controls. 
•	Prepares payments by verifying documentation and requesting disbursements. 
•	Conducting research and interpreting accounting policy and regulations. 
•	Complies with local, state and federal legal requirements by studying new rules and regulations. 
•	Enforces the legal requirements. 
•	Substantiates financial transactions by auditing documents. 
•	Maintains employer's confidence and protects operations by keeping financial information confidential. 
•	Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, participating in professional societies, establishing personal networks, and reviewing professional publications.






REQUIRED SKILLS
•	Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a closely related field. 
•	At least one year of relevant post-qualification experience as an Accountant or in a similar accounting role  
•	Strong knowledge of Australian accounting principles, taxation requirements, financial reporting standards and relevant legislation. 
•	Experience in preparing financial statements, budgets, cash flow reports, payroll and management reports. 
•	Proficiency in accounting software (e.g. Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks) and Microsoft Excel. 
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and numerical skills with excellent attention to detail. 
•	Ability to interpret financial data and provide practical recommendations to support business decision-making. 
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. 
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively with management, suppliers and external stakeholders. 
•	High level of integrity, confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive financial information. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment. 
•	Knowledge of inventory control, internal controls, budgeting and audit processes is highly regarded.

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 Aug 2026.
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Spray Painter to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition. Colour mix and match vehicle after vehicle has been prepared and is scheduled for painting

Handle all vehicles with due care and attention
Notate any extra paint work required that is not quoted for.

Coach apprentices when required

Physiotherapist - Full Time/Part-time/Flexible  

Do you want to take the next step in your career development?  

Are you looking to work in private practice and be a name, not just a number?  

Would you like to get out of the City and move to a Regional Location, becoming part of a community?  
   

  About Health First Group   

With 20 site locations nationally, Health First Group employs dedicated allied health professionals from around the World, who focus on physiotherapy, headache therapy, massage, acupuncture, clinical pilates, orthotics, shockwave therapy, posture analysis, and corporate health. We also specialise in occupational rehabilitation including workplace assessments, suitable duties programs, return to work plans and pre-employment assessments.  

 
  Commencing immediately .  

  Salary range:  $80,000 - $110,000 + performance driven bonuses.  
   

Reporting to the Director you will be responsible for providing our clients with care and taking accountability in their journey back to better health, while aligning yourself with our core Values; Care, Accountability, Relationships, Evolve.  

Right now, Health First Group has a rare opportunity for an experienced Physiotherapist to join our rapidly growing team. As a qualified physiotherapist, you will assess, treat and prevent physical difficulties resulting from injury, illness, disability or ageing to improve movement and general wellbeing. In this role, you will have the opportunity to independently manage a varied caseload of MSK Clients including Private Patients, DVA, Workcover & EPC Clients.  
   

  What we offer   

An Employer/Employee Value Proposition like you never experienced  

Competitive salary and benefits package  

Ongoing professional learning and development including mentoring and coaching  

A diverse and inclusive work environment  

Career pathways and networking opportunities  

Organised 1:1’s, fortnightly teaching and journal clubs  

Fully equipped practices with pilates reformer, shock therapy, acupuncture, exercise physiology, massage therapy, computerised gait analysis, advanced posture screening software, OH&S training and rehabilitation, manual handling seminars  

   
  What you offer   

Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Physiotherapy  

AHPRA registration required  

At least 2 years’ experience as a registered Physiotherapists with 1-year experience in private practice  

Understanding of the rights of people with a disability 

Current Valid Driver's License  

Current Working with Children Check or willingness to obtain one before commencement 

Are you interested?   Apply Today.
